English: Trap Set
Simple traps and snares set by the first hunters, enabling a steady trickle of wild game and minor boosts to the population and food supply.
Hunters Blind
A makeshift camouflaged shelter for patient hunters, improving hunting yields, food security, and clan sentiment.
Game Rack
A primitive wooden rack for preserving and curing game, providing better food storage and increased population and manpower capacity.
Trackers Tent
A tent for skilled trackers and guides
French: increases horde mobility and population, and improves clan sentiment through shared bounty.

English: Hunting Pavilion
A large, sturdy pavilion for communal hunts, feasts, and gatherings, greatly enhancing population, manpower, supply, and unity. Requires Construction tech.
Fletchers Cabin
A skilled fletcher crafts arrows for the horde, improving archery and military capability of the clan. Requires Fortifications tech.
Bowyers Workshop
A dedicated workshop for crafting advanced bows, further increasing military strength and boosting manpower and supplies. Requires City Construction tech.
Master Hunters Lodge
A grand lodge for the most skilled hunters, providing elite training, increased supply, and morale for the entire horde. Requires Construction III.
Gamekeepers Hall
A fortified hall for master gamekeepers, ensuring the prosperity of the clans herds and game, and granting strong boosts to manpower, supply, and clan unity. Requires Fortifications IV.
Grand Hunters Pavilion

A prestigious and awe-inspiring pavilion where great hunts and gatherings are held, uniting the clan and attracting the best hunters from afar. The ultimate symbol of nomadic hunting mastery. Requires City Construction V.
